subject: MedSecure Health — data lifecycle checklist & SLA clarifications
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Gibbs <laura.gibbs@medsecurehealth.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2026 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: MedSecure Health — data lifecycle checklist & SLA clarifications

Hi Laura —

Thanks again for taking the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side so we keep alignment on the security/compliance items that matter to you:

1) SOC 2 status: you asked about our current SOC 2 report cadence. We are in-scope for SOC 2 Type II; last assessment completed May 2026 and the report will be available to customers under NDA.

2) Data residency & GDPR/HIPAA: Redwood supports customer-controlled VPC deployments for regulated workloads (we showed the private option on the demo). For hosted API customers, we offer region pinning and data isolation controls. We will provide our data processing addendum (DPA) and HIPAA BA addendum samples.

3) Retention/deletion SLAs: From our standard policy — primary data (request/response) retained for 30 days by default, with customer-configurable windows from 0–365 days. Backups are retained for up to 90 days in encrypted form unless otherwise negotiated. We can offer a contract clause to shorten backup retention for MedSecure to match your internal policy.

4) Log retention and access logs: Access logs (auth + admin actions) are retained for 365 days in hosted mode. Application-level request logs are retained per the customer setting noted above. We can produce audit exports on request and set up S3 delivery for long-term retention.

5) Vendor security questionnaire (you mentioned a spreadsheet): please attach it and we will triage Qs into technical / legal buckets for faster turnaround.

Proposed immediate next steps:
- Laura: share the vendor security questionnaire (SVQ) and any procurement redlines (you indicated procurement will follow up).
- Neha: own pricing / DPA / BA template follow-up once procurement sends redlines.
- Vivek: technical owner to coordinate SOC 2 report access and provide a short technical note on backup encryption & key management.
- Olga: I will put together a short one-page data lifecycle checklist and a proposed retention SLA that matches the points above and circulate by EOD Thu (Aug 31).

If that matches, I’ll send the summary + attachments.

Best,
Olga
Olga Petrov
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com
+1 415-555-0192

Attachment: redwood-data-lifecycle-summary.pdf (summary sheet, 2 pages)

From: Laura Gibbs <laura.gibbs@medsecurehealth.com>

Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2026 17:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MedSecure Health — data lifecycle checklist & SLA clarifications

Thanks, Olga — all correct from our side. Attaching the vendor security questionnaire (SVQ) — it's a mix of checkbox items and a few free-text questions on encryption and breach notification. High priorities for us:

- Confirmed availability of SOC 2 Type II (we'll need the report under NDA).
- Clarify backup retention and how quickly backups can be purged on request. Our internal policy requires backups containing patient data to be retrievable for 90 days but removable within 14 days of a contractual deletion request.
- HIPAA BA addendum — procurement will want the standard template.
- Audit exports to be delivered monthly to our secure S3 bucket (we can share details).

I'll loop in procurement to raise any contract redlines. Please confirm expected turnaround on the SVQ and when we can get the SOC 2 report access.

Best,
Laura
Laura Gibbs
Head of Information Security | MedSecure Health
laura.gibbs@medsecurehealth.com

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 31 Aug 2026 09:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MedSecure Health — data lifecycle checklist & SLA clarifications

Olga / Neha — quick technical notes after I reviewed the SVQ Laura sent:

- SOC 2 report: legal will prepare the NDA; once signed we provide a redacted Type II report within 2 business days. If they need full logs or raw evidence, we'll coordinate with Security/Compliance for a controlled review session.

- Backups: backups are encrypted at rest with customer keys (KMS) in dedicated capacity and with provider-managed KMS in hosted. For the BA/hosted case, we can offer a 14-day purge SLA for backup artifacts that contain customer data, but it requires a short change window and confirmation that no active snapshots depend on the objects. There's a technical procedure and a ticketed process to trigger purge; turnaround estimate: 10–14 business days from request receipt. If MedSecure requires a stricter SLA (e.g., <7 days), we can discuss an add-on with higher operational commitment.

- Log exports: we can deliver audit exports via S3 transfer; retention on our side for auth/admin logs is 365 days. If they want longer retention, we recommend delivering to their bucket for any >365 day need.

Action items for our team:
- Vivek: draft the backup purge procedure (include steps, authorizations, and estimated windows) — ETA Sep 2.
- Neha: coordinate DPA/BA template and procurement touchpoint.
- Priyom: prepare a short note for CS about what deletion requests mean for embedded caches and customer-controlled prefix caching so MedSecure can set expectations in integration docs.

I'll start the draft procedure and link it into the shared Drive.

— Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: MedSecure Health — data lifecycle checklist & SLA clarifications

Laura / Team — following up with the promised artifacts and timelines. See links and attachments below:

1) Attached: redwood-data-lifecycle-summary.pdf (two-pager) — includes default retention windows, backup policy summary, and log types.
2) Drive link with technical backup purge procedure (Vivek) — https://drive.redwoodinference.com/dirs/RWF-3742/shared-data-lifecycle-checklist (Vivek will update with step-by-step).
3) SOC 2: NDA link (DocuSign) — https://app.docusign.com/documents/RWF-3742-NDA (please sign; we'll provision report within 2 business days of execution).
4) BA/DPA: Neha will send the standard templates and note any optional clauses we typically offer for private deployments.

Summary of proposed contractual points for clarity:
- Primary request/response data retention: default 30 days, configurable 0–365 days.
- Backup retention: default 90 days; can be shortened to 14 days via addendum and manual purge process (purge ETA 10–14 business days).
- Auth/admin log retention: 365 days; audit exports can be scheduled to external S3 for longer retention.
- SOC 2 Type II: available under NDA (provision within 2 business days of signed NDA).

Next steps / ownership:
- Laura: sign NDA (DocuSign link) and confirm procurement timeline for contract redlines.
- Procurement: share any required contract language around backup purge SLA if <14 days.
- Vivek: finalize and upload purge procedure (ETA EOD Sep 2).
- Neha: send BA/DPA and coordinate procurement meeting (ETA Sep 3).

If anyone needs this in a shorter slide or for legal, I can coordinate a brief 20-minute handoff meeting next week — propose Tue Sep 7 at 10am PT.

Thanks — looking forward to closing next steps.

Olga
Olga Petrov
